correctness.rationale: Proof covers arbitrary finite metric graphs and non-piecewise-affine Lipschitz functions. Edgewise area/coarea limits the measure of one-crossing levels by B; quantile derivative has excess budget; strict convexity and the strictly concave first-variation potential give the unique central interval; exact integration yields the formula; balanced barbell attains. Exact rational checker verified discrete variational comparisons, sharpness identities and 16,200 graph cases. Independent validation not performed.

value.rationale: Determines the full sharp topology-independent Lipschitz-to-centered-L2 embedding norm envelope from two natural geometric statistics L and total bridge length B, for all feasible B, with a structurally new balanced-barbell equality law. The nonlinearly interpolating constant distinguishes a single central bottleneck from one-ended pendants. It is not an arbitrary finite slice or a mere renaming of the bridgeless B=0 case.
